name: dpi-controle-de-estoque
description: Sistema de controle de estoque e maquinário para gráfica / comunicação visual.
author: Felipe Neneu Desenvolvedor

scripts.dev:web: concurrently --names backend,ui --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.app: concurrently --names backend,ui,electron --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ui" "npm run start:electron"
scripts.app:preview: npm run build:export && concurrently --names backend,electron --prefix-colors cyan,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run start:electron:static"
scripts.build:cli: dotnet publish sidecars/AutoImposerCLI -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o sidecars/bin/cli
scripts.build:cli:illustrator: dotnet publish sidecars/IllustratorImposerCLI -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o sidecars/bin/cli
scripts.build:core: cd packages && dotnet build imposition.slnx -c Release
scripts.build:all: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && npm run build:cli:illustrator && npm run build:backend && npm run build:export
scripts.lint: npm --prefix grafica-app run lint && npm --prefix grafica-app/backend run lint
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:export && npm run build:backend && npm --prefix electron run start:server
scripts.e2e:build: npm run build:export && npm run build:backend
scripts.package:electron: npm run package:server && npm run package:client
scripts.package:server: npm run build:export && npm run build:backend && npm --prefix electron run package:server
scripts.package:client: npm run build:export && npm --prefix electron run package:client
